name: Engine Management
description: Engine control for the Gen V LT direct-injection engine: factory E92 ECM via a Chevrolet Performance Connect & Cruise / controller kit, or a race standalone with direct-injection capability (Holley Terminator X Max GM Gen V LT DI kit, MoTeC M1 GPR-DI). Includes the engine harness interface, drive-by-wire pedal and throttle, DI injector and high-pressure pump drive, ignition coil sub-harness, wideband lambda, flex-fuel option and tuning access.

components.name: Engine control unit (ECU / ECM)
components.description: Controls direct injection (high-voltage peak-and-hold DI injectors + cam-driven high-pressure pump solenoid), coil-near-plug ignition, drive-by-wire throttle, VVT cam phaser, AFM/DFM (disable), alternator, fans and fuel pump requests. The factory LT1/LT4 uses the GM E92 ECM; Chevrolet Performance sells pre-calibrated controller kits that run the crate engine standalone (no BCM). A race build moves to a standalone that logs and tunes freely – but must support GDI, which narrows the choice.
components.location: Factory: engine bay (OE Gen 6 bracket location – confirm on your car). Race: inside the cabin on the passenger-side electronics panel (x≈1.00, y≈0.48, z≈-0.30), away from heat and water.

factory.name: GM E92 ECM (LT4) via Chevrolet Performance LT4 controller kit
factory.partNumber: 19433248 (LT4 kit, ZL1 6-speed manual / 4L, 3-pin fuel pressure sensor); 19433249 (LT4 kit, 8L90/10L90); 19419241 (earlier LT4 kit, 3-pin FPS, 4L75E/T56)
factory.notes: Retailer listings: kit includes programmed E92 controller, engine harness with fuse box, drive-by-wire pedal, 2 O2 sensors with bosses, MAF with boss, oil pressure sensor, fuel pump power module and fuel pressure sensor. Pre-2022 LT1/LT4 controllers must NOT be used with 2022+ LT crate engines. Locked calibrations need HP Tuners/EFILive-style unlocking to tune.

raceOptions.name: Holley Terminator X Max GM Gen V LT4 Direct Injection Kit – Late (3-pin FPS)
raceOptions.notes: Includes external GDI controller that drives factory DI injectors, HP pump and VVT; DBW; logging. Early engines with 4-pin fuel pressure sensor use 550-1623.

raceOptions.name: MoTeC M1 (M142 / M182) with GPR-DI package
raceOptions.notes: General-purpose race GDI package for 1–12 cyl with synchronous DI pumps. Does not include OE CAN messaging (ABS, power steering, dash) – plan for that. Confirm LT-specific sync/injector drive with a MoTeC dealer.

raceOptions.name: MoTeC M150 (port-injection race conversion)
raceOptions.notes: 12 P&H injector, 10 half-bridge, 3 CAN, 250 MB logging, Ethernet. Only applicable if the race engine is converted to port injection (common in LT race engines with a port-injected intake).

raceOptions.name: Holley Dominator EFI ECU
raceOptions.notes: Port-injection only (no GDI controller) – for a port-injected race LT conversion.

specs.Injection: Gasoline direct injection, 8 injectors (~65–90 V peak drive)

hardware.spec: M5 or M6 screws through rubber isolators

hardware.item: Factory E92 ECM bracket bolts (if retained in engine bay)

hardware.spec: E92: 2 x OE header connectors with slide locks; MoTeC M1: Tyco 34 + 26 pin

installNotes: Decide ECU strategy before building the harness: OE E92 kit (lowest cost, proven DI control) vs standalone GDI (full logging/tuning control).
Mount the ECU in the cabin with connectors facing down; leave a service loop.
Power the ECU from a PDM channel; ECU power grounds to the star ground; sensor grounds only to ECU pins.
Load base calibration, verify crank/cam sync on the starter (no fuel), then verify fuel pressure and injector drive before first fire.

components.name: Direct-injection driver / GDI controller
components.description: High-voltage injector driver and HP pump solenoid driver. Inside the factory E92; external box with the Holley Terminator X Max Gen V kit. DI injector wiring carries high voltage – keep pairs twisted, unspliced and away from sensor signals.
components.location: Next to the ECU in the cabin (Holley), or integrated (E92/MoTeC).

raceOptions.name: Holley GDI controller (Terminator X Gen V LT)
raceOptions.notes: Supplied in 550-1623/550-1624 kits; controls injectors, VVT and pumps.

installNotes: Mount with good airflow; it dissipates heat at high rpm.

components.name: Engine harness
components.description: Harness on the engine from the firewall bulkhead to injectors, coils, crank/cam sensors, knock sensors, ETC throttle, MAP/TMAP, ECT, oil pressure/temp, HP pump, VVT solenoid, fuel-rail pressure, alternator, starter trigger, O2/wideband. Factory/controller-kit harness is PVC/convoluted; a race harness is Tefzel (M22759/32) with DR-25 jacket, Deutsch AS bulkhead and DTM/DT/OE sensor plugs, with a service loop for engine movement.
components.location: On top/sides of the engine, exiting at the passenger firewall bulkhead.

factory.name: Engine harness supplied in Chevrolet Performance controller kit
factory.notes: Kit-specific harness with fuse box; not repairable to motorsport standard but plug-and-play.

raceOptions.name: Custom mil-spec engine harness (Spec 55 / DR-25 / Deutsch AS)
raceOptions.notes: ~40 % lighter and serviceable; built on an engine-shaped harness board.

raceOptions.name: Holley Gen V LT DI main harness (in 550-1624)

specs.Breakouts: Raychem 202K/ 202D boots with Resintech RT-125 adhesive

hardware.spec: Cushioned stainless P-clamps on existing M6/M8 engine studs
hardware.torque: M6: 10 N·m (89 in-lb); M8: 25 N·m (18 ft-lb) – per the engine stud it shares

installNotes: Build the race harness on a board using measurements from the installed engine (or a mock-up) so lengths fit exactly.
Leave ~50–75 mm service loop at the bulkhead for engine roll.
Route away from headers (≥ 150 mm) or add reflective sleeve; keep DI injector pairs away from crank/cam and knock signals.
Continuity-test every circuit before connecting the ECU.
inspection: Chafe at clamps, heat damage near headers, connector locks.

modelRef.dimensions: Main trunk Ø~24 mm over DR-25.
modelRef.features: Black DR-25 jacket, Raychem boots, Autosport bulkhead plug at the firewall, Adel clamps.

components.name: DI injector sub-harness
components.description: Per-bank twisted-pair harness from the ECU/GDI controller to the 4 direct injectors on each bank. High-voltage (boost) drive – no splices, use OE-spec connectors and keep separate from sensor wiring.
components.location: Under the intake manifold along each cylinder head (DI injectors are in the head).

specs.Wire: 18 AWG twisted pair, ~1 twist per 25 mm

hardware.spec: OE GDI injector connector with CPA

installNotes: Install before the intake manifold goes on.

modelRef.dimensions: Ø~12 mm branch with an injector plug every cylinder.

components.name: Ignition coil sub-harness
components.description: Per-bank harness to the 4 coil-near-plug coils on each valve cover (power from PDM ignition channel, ground to head, EST signal from ECU).
components.location: Valve cover coil rails, each bank.

specs.Power: 14 AWG per bank, PDM 20 A channel

installNotes: Ground the coil bracket to the head with a dedicated eyelet.

modelRef.dimensions: Ø~12 mm branch along each coil rail.

components.name: Accelerator pedal position sensor (drive-by-wire pedal)
components.description: Dual-track APP sensor pedal (redundant signals) feeding the ECU, which commands the electronic throttle body. The Chevrolet Performance controller kit includes a GM pedal; race builds often use a floor-mount pedal box with a separate dual-track sensor.

factory.name: GM DBW accelerator pedal assembly (included in LT controller kit)

raceOptions.name: Floor-mount pedal box with Bosch/CTS dual-track pedal sensor
raceOptions.notes: Must match the ECU's APP calibration (two tracks, ratio check).

installNotes: Calibrate pedal min/max in the ECU and check both tracks track correctly before startup.

modelRef.dimensions: GM hanging DBW pedal ~180 mm tall (estimated).
modelRef.features: Black plastic sensor housing/bracket at the top, arm, rubber pad, 6-pin connector.

components.name: Wideband lambda sensors & controller
components.description: One Bosch LSU 4.9 wideband per bank for tuning and data (the OE system uses upstream O2 sensors supplied in the controller kit). Mount in the collector/primary merge at 10 or 2 o'clock, ≥ 450 mm from exhaust ports if possible, before any catalyst.
components.location: Exhaust collectors/downpipes, each side under the car (x≈0.70, y≈0.25, z≈±0.25).

factory.name: GM heated O2 sensors with weld bosses (in controller kit)

raceOptions.name: Bosch LSU 4.9 + MoTeC LTCD (dual lambda to CAN)

hardware.notes: Bosch LSU 4.9 installation torque 40–60 N·m per Bosch guidance; GM O2 sensors 42 N·m typical.

installNotes: Mount bung above horizontal so condensation drains away from the sensor.
Never run the engine with a cold, unpowered wideband in the exhaust.
inspection: Sensor reading sanity at idle/WOT; harness heat damage.

components.name: Flex-fuel (ethanol content) sensor – optional
components.description: Continental/GM-style ethanol-content sensor in the fuel feed line that outputs a frequency (50–150 Hz = 0–100 % ethanol) plus fuel temperature. Lets the ECU blend timing/fuel maps for E85 – mainly useful on the supercharged LT4 for charge cooling and knock margin. Check series fuel rules first.
components.location: Low-pressure fuel feed line, front of the car near the frame rail before the high-pressure pump.

factory.name: GM flex fuel sensor (used on GM FFV trucks)

installNotes: Use AN adapter fittings rated for E85.
